desc: Systems, evidence, and the craft of making AI dependable.
bio: Pathan Afnan Khan is an Indian Data Scientist 2 at Hyland, AI engineer and entrepreneur focused on trustworthy AI systems, technical architecture and practical innovation.

articles.title: Production AI Is a Systems Problem
articles.desc: A successful prototype proves possibility. A production system must prove reliability.
points: Production AI must manage latency, failure recovery, security, cost and human escalation.
Separate retrieval, policy, orchestration and tool execution so failures are diagnosable.
Golden sets and online metrics should be continuous infrastructure.

articles.title: Designing Trustworthy Enterprise Assistants
articles.desc: Enterprise assistants need strong retrieval, permissions, observability and human control.
points: Identity, permissions and approval gates belong in the architecture from the beginning.
Citations and provenance make answers inspectable and debuggable.
Trace prompts, context, outputs, tools and feedback.

articles.title: Choosing the Right AI Architecture
articles.desc: Not every problem needs an agent, a vector database or the newest model.
points: Use deterministic pipelines when the steps are known.
Use agents only when sequencing genuinely needs dynamic reasoning.
Keep components replaceable as models and providers evolve.
